tithi.name: Purnima
tithi.description: The full moon day symbolizes completion, fulfillment and the culmination of efforts; it is auspicious for spiritual practices and gratitude.

Mesha.summary: Energy surges, making it a great day to start new initiatives.
Mesha.general: Moon in fiery Simha energises Aries, boosting confidence and optimism. Use this vigor for creative projects.
Mesha.career: Your leadership shines; take bold steps at work and propose innovative ideas.
Mesha.finance: Financial prospects look bright—consider modest investments that align with your passions.
Mesha.relationships: Passionate interactions are favoured; express your feelings openly.
Mesha.health: Physical stamina is high—engage in vigorous exercise but avoid overexertion.
Mesha.remedy: Light a ghee lamp and chant the Gayatri mantra after sunrise.

Vrishabha.summary: Steady progress marks the day, encouraging patience.
Vrishabha.general: Moon in Simha offers a calm backdrop for Taurus, supporting methodical work and practical decisions.
Vrishabha.career: Focus on detailed tasks; your reliability will be recognised by superiors.
Vrishabha.finance: Maintain a disciplined budget; small savings will accumulate over time.
Vrishabha.relationships: Comfort in familiar company; nurture existing bonds rather than seeking new ones.
Vrishabha.health: Maintain a balanced diet; avoid indulgent sweets that can upset digestion.
Vrishabha.remedy: Offer fresh flowers to a nearby deity and recite the Vishnu Sahasranama.

Mithuna.summary: Communication flows smoothly, ideal for networking.
Mithuna.general: Gemini benefits from the expressive Moon in Simha, enhancing verbal skills and social interactions.
Mithuna.career: Engage in meetings and presentations; your ideas will be well received.
Mithuna.finance: Opportunities for short‑term gains appear—evaluate them carefully before acting.
Mithuna.relationships: Light‑hearted conversations strengthen friendships; avoid gossip.
Mithuna.health: Mental agility is high; practice meditation to channel it positively.
Mithuna.remedy: Wear a yellow sapphire (if suitable) and chant the mantra 'Om Namo Narayanaya'.

Karka.summary: Emotions run deep; practice inner balance.
Karka.general: Moon opposite Cancer can stir sensitivities; stay grounded and avoid reactive decisions.
Karka.career: Delay major commitments; focus on completing pending tasks instead.
Karka.finance: Unexpected expenses may arise—keep a contingency fund ready.
Karka.relationships: Tend to over‑react; practice patience and open dialogue with loved ones.
Karka.health: Watch for digestive issues; opt for light, warm meals.
Karka.remedy: Perform a simple water offering (Abhisheka) to a Shiva lingam and chant 'Om Namah Shivaya'.
